description: Getting Started with Claude Cowork — education module for browser-based AI tasks

module.title: Using Claude Cowork for Web Tasks
module.outcome: Understanding when to use Cowork vs Code and your first browser automation

sections.title: Claude Code vs Claude Cowork
sections.content: Claude Code and Cowork serve different purposes. Code is the builder — it creates things, writes integrations, builds skills. Cowork is the operator — it can use any website or web app just like you would, clicking, typing, navigating.

comparison.why: Requires coding and file system access
Web portal that needs login and navigation

sections.title: What Cowork Can Do
sections.content: Cowork uses computer use capabilities to interact with any web application. It can see screens, click buttons, type text, and navigate — just like a human assistant would.
capabilities: Navigate web portals (insurance, banking, government sites)
Fill out online forms and applications
Extract data from websites without APIs

sections.title: When to Use Cowork in Your AIOS
sections.content: Cowork fills the gaps where APIs and MCP servers don't exist. Some business tools only have web interfaces — Cowork can automate those too.

use_cases.example: Your dental PMS only has a web portal — Cowork can log in and extract patient data
Research 10 competitor websites and summarize their pricing
Check tax filing status, download compliance certificates
Check supplier websites weekly for price changes
